mechanism_hypothesis: Blanket quotation protection makes quote-contained SynthID n-gram windows unreachable. Distributed ASCII spacing edits retokenize those windows without changing quoted words, attribution, facts, or delimiter bytes.
candidate_identity: Existing rule-bound transform candidate ID over input hash, rule identity, source geometry, and replacement bytes; quote policy is bound into the registry ruleset hash.

applicability.allowed_change: Add exactly one U+0020 ASCII space before or after the matched surface span.
applicability.container: Operation must remain strictly inside exactly one recognized quotation container and cannot touch either delimiter.
applicability.truncated_generation: A fail-closed ASCII or curly double-quote container extending to line/sample end may admit the same spacing-only operation because no quoted byte is removed or substituted.

protected_content_invariants.quotation: Quote containers govern candidate admission; quoted non-whitespace bytes are reconstructed exactly from the operation trace.

sanitizer_analysis.cf_strip: U+0020 is not a format character.
sanitizer_analysis.combined: Identical to raw for this family.
sanitizer_analysis.whitespace_collapse: Expected to remove the mechanism; not part of the frozen four-arm sanitizer protocol and recorded as an adverse limitation.

fidelity_gate.claim_boundary: Detector-zero development evidence is valid; fidelity-complete or release-ready status is not claimed until the packet is independently adjudicated.

disjoint_development_replication.claim_boundary: Unseen development replication only; not formal confirmation.

budget_ablation.selection_reason: Minimum tested integer budget reaching 0/16 on the frozen development corpus; candidate ranking remained detector-blind.

kill_criteria: Any exact protected item, quote delimiter, non-whitespace quoted byte, negation, or modality changes.
Any raw/NFKC/Cf-strip/combined detection count exceeds the fixed ZRD baseline on the frozen16 development corpus.
Either original residual remains detected at the unchanged threshold.
Independent blind review labels either residual as meaning-changing or major degradation.
A planner accesses detector scores, SynthID keys, or secret detector state.
